highlight.iterationLive.reason: The ABI has no live iterator: Highlight.values() returns a snapshot copy, so a set mutated during iteration leaves the snapshot unchanged (highlight.iterationSnapshot and highlight.afterIteration equal Chromium).

paint.redReplaced.reason: As paint.redSetAgain: replacing the highlight of the registered name 'red' keeps its map position; Chromium paints it on top, native keeps the registry iteration order (green on top).

paint.redSetAgain.reason: Chromium paints a re-set name as the most recently registered while keeping its map position, so Chromium's paint order disagrees with its own iteration order (keys stay [red, green]). Native paints equal-priority highlights in registry iteration order, so the later-registered green stays on top.

registry.iterationLive.reason: The ABI has no live iterator: HighlightRegistry.entries() returns a snapshot copy, so a map mutated during iteration leaves the snapshot unchanged (registry.iterationSnapshot and registry.afterIteration equal Chromium).
